name: newmedia-matrix
description: 新媒体矩阵专家市场 - 1 位矩阵操盘总监 + 7 位内容生产与风控专业专家
description_en: New Media Matrix Expert Marketplace - one matrix director plus seven content and compliance specialists

plugins.name: matrix-director
plugins.description: Veteran new media matrix director orchestrating topic, writing, polish, platform, visual, data and legal-compliance agents in a daily PDCA loop.

plugins.name: topic-insight-analyst
plugins.description: Topic insight analyst who mines niche trends, audience pain points and viral factors to build a ranked topic pool with explicit selection rationale.

plugins.name: draft-chief-writer
plugins.description: Chief content writer who turns a locked topic into a sharp, well-structured master draft with a clear viewpoint, real supporting cases and a closed logic chain.

plugins.name: dehumanizing-polisher
plugins.description: Humanization editor who strips AI tells, template feel and mechanical structure from any draft, delivering a natural-voiced rewrite with a line-by-line change log.

plugins.name: platform-content-architect
plugins.description: Multi-platform content architect who adapts one master draft into five platform-native versions with tailored titles, hooks, tags and compliance checks.

plugins.name: visual-prompt-planner
plugins.description: Visual planner who designs cover and inline image schemes for five platforms and writes image-tool-ready AI prompts with composition, lighting, palette and negative words.

plugins.name: data-review-analyst
plugins.description: Data review analyst who attributes cross-platform metrics, grades content S/A/B/C and returns viral factor teardowns plus next-day quantified fixes.

plugins.name: legal-compliance-auditor
plugins.description: Legal and compliance final reviewer who runs platform-rules, advertising-law and legal-risk checks on every outgoing post and holds veto power to block anything unsafe.
